disclaimer.title: Disclaimer and risk notice
disclaimer.item1: This mini game involves no gambling, and no real-money bets or transactions.
disclaimer.item2: It only offers a playful way to earn a daily allowance; all settlement is an in-site mechanic.
disclaimer.item3: Gambling can lead to addiction, debt, broken family relationships and mental health problems. Stay away from all real gambling.

mines.title: Mines
mines.desc: 5 mines hidden in a 5×5 grid — the more you clear, the higher the payout

rules.title: Rules
rules.item1: Five mines hide in a 5×5 grid; each safe tile raises the multiplier.
rules.item2: Cash out any time; hit a mine and the whole bet is lost.
rules.item3: Bet range 100 ~ 50,000, including a 1% fee (already priced into the multiplier).

blackjack.title: Blackjack
blackjack.desc: Classic blackjack, play the dealer with points
blackjack.poolExhausted: Today's pool is used up. It resets tomorrow.

rules.title: Rules and notes
rules.basics1: Get your hand as close to 21 as possible without going over; over 21 is a bust.
rules.basics2: An ace counts as 1 or 11; J/Q/K count as 10.
rules.basics3: Player and dealer are each dealt two cards, then you act on your hand.
rules.basics4: After all player hands are done the dealer plays, and results are settled.
rules.actions2: Stand (STAND): take no more cards and end the hand.
rules.actions3: Double (DOUBLE): double the bet, take exactly one card, then stand automatically.
rules.actions4: Split (SPLIT): when the first two cards allow it, play two hands, each settled on its own.
rules.actions5: Insurance (INSURANCE): only when the dealer's up card is an ace, at the first decision.
rules.points1: Points are an in-site virtual number used for settlement and display inside the mini games.
rules.points2: A daily floor of 200 points is topped up automatically the next day.
rules.points4: Anything above the 200 floor can be transferred out to the game wallet, up to 500 per day.
rules.points5: The daily pool is shared site-wide; once it is empty no new hands start that day.

resume.title: Unfinished hand
resume.body: You have an unfinished hand. Continue or forfeit? Forfeiting loses the points already staked.
resume.bodyWithBet: You have an unfinished hand (bet: {{amount}}). Continue or forfeit? Forfeiting loses the points already staked.

videoPoker.title: Video Poker
videoPoker.desc: Classic Jacks or Better — a pair of jacks returns your bet
videoPoker.holdHint: Tap the cards you want to hold

rules.basics1: One standard 52-card deck (no jokers) — make the highest hand you can
rules.basics2: Five cards are dealt after the bet; choose which ones to HOLD
rules.basics3: On the draw, unheld cards are replaced and the payout table settles the hand
rules.handDesc1: <0>Royal Flush</0> A K Q J 10 suited · <1>Straight Flush</1> five suited cards in sequence · <2>Four of a Kind</2> four of the same rank
rules.handDesc2: <0>Full House</0> three of a kind plus a pair · <1>Flush</1> five of the same suit · <2>Straight</2> five cards in sequence
rules.handDesc3: <0>Three of a Kind</0> three of the same rank · <1>Two Pair</1> two pairs · <2>Jacks or Better</2> a pair of jacks or higher (returns your bet)
